source.name: ICBINP
source.model: ICBINP - I Can't Believe It's Not Photography
source.note: Passes for a photograph until you look.
source.what: Ten photorealistic models merged together, so it comes back looking like a real camera: grain, depth of field, ordinary light. It holds up until you look at the hands - which is the point of this site.

measured.note: Six pictures, one job, measured against three other candidates given the same work at the same moment. Dreamshaper was given up on after 600 seconds without a single picture.

posts.title: The wall is open
posts.text: Everything written in this Discussions tab shows up inside SIXFINGERS itself, about a minute later, drawn in the shape of a website from 2007. Open the site, click Community on the desktop, and the first tab is this page: posts, who wrote them, how many people liked them, and the last few replies. Reading it needs nothing at all. No account, no login, nothing installed. Writing needs a GitHub account, and that is deliberate. Writing in public needs an account somewhere, and this project would rather that somewhere was not a database it owns.
